summary: Iteration 98: Validated the new BRUNO showcase card system (glamour/noir/editorial/spotlight presets) and the Daily.co live recording + summary pipeline. Backend 12/12 passing (test_iteration98_cards_lives.py): POST/GET/PUT /api/cards with links[] + showcase{} persists; legacy card d16c2745 still returns preset='classic' with its original title; POST /api/lives/{id}/recording/start → 409 with Spanish 'La grabación empieza cuando tu cámara ya está en vivo…' when nobody is in the Daily room; GET /api/lives/{id}/summary returns the 10 required fields; GET /api/lives/{id}/recording returns {status:'none'} before any recording; non-host (viewer2) gets 403 on both summary and recording endpoints; end live 200. Frontend (login as newtest@bruno.com): /cards/new shows the 4 showcase tiles (preset-glamour, preset-noir, preset-editorial, preset-spotlight) under 'Glamour y presentación personal' heading, with visually distinct scaled renders (not just recolors). Built a full card for each of the 4 presets end-to-end: tab-content (title/alias/specialty/city, section-purpose expanded to fill booking email), tab-social (link-add-btn adds a featured link, link-down-0/link-up-1 reorder controls present), tab-media (section-framing + focus-x/y/zoom sliders present, section-featured expands to show input-featured-title/url). save-status reached data-status='saved', publish-btn navigates to /c/{id}. Public cards verified: glamour→card-hero, noir→card-portrait+card-specialty, editorial→card-editorial, spotlight→card-hero; card-links-block + card-link-0 href==typed URL; card-purpose-block + card-purpose-booking href=mailto:booking@test.com; card-pro-block visible. Legacy card /c/d16c2745… still renders classic (card-container+card-title present, card-hero=0). In /cards/d16c2745…/edit the Design tab compact preset picker shows all 12 real presets (custom, classic, minimal, modern, glass, formal, photo, animated, glamour, noir, editorial, spotlight) with no console errors; header-mode group has classic/hero/portrait/editorial and switching hero↔classic works. Live summary page /lives/{id}/summary for the pre-ready live 796cea11… shows live-summary-page, live-summary-duration, live-summary-peak, 14 stat-* cards, live-summary-recording with data-status='ready', and live-summary-publish-btn that navigates to /camera?drafts=1 where the drafts sheet opens and lists 'Repetición del live…' as expected. All 4 test cards were deleted after the run.

issues: Minor horizontal overflow of ~16px by an empty-class <ol> element (right=406px vs viewport=390). The main card container itself is fine; the stray OL likely comes from the floating action/toast dock. Non-critical but surfaces as a tiny horizontal scroll.

action_items: (Optional, minor) Hunt down the stray <ol> that overflows the mobile viewport on public showcase cards and either constrain its width or add overflow-hidden on the public card wrapper (ignoring the known blur-[140px] glow).

(Code-review) utils/card_design.ensure_design() wipes any card_design that was POSTed WITHOUT a top-level 'version' field (first subsequent GET regenerates from legacy_template → preset reverts to 'classic'). The current frontend always sends version=DESIGN_VERSION via DEFAULT_DESIGN, so production users are not affected — but any 3rd-party API client that posts card_design={preset:'glamour', …} without 'version' will see their preset silently reset. Consider also honoring card_design.preset when version is absent, or require version via Pydantic validation to fail fast.
critical_code_review_comments: ContentPanel.jsx: section-purpose is defaultOpen only when sc.booking/collab/press already have values. Users (and automated tests) opening a fresh showcase card won't see 'Contrataciones' email field without scrolling+clicking the collapsed section header. Consider defaultOpen={showcase} so showcase presets expand this section automatically.

MediaPanel.jsx: same pattern on section-featured (defaultOpen only when sc.featured_title/image already present). For glamour/noir/editorial/spotlight the Featured block is a hero feature of the preset — opening it by default when the preset is a showcase one would improve discoverability.

backend/utils/card_design.py:97 ensure_design() uses the presence of card_design.version as the sole 'is modern design' signal. A client that posts {card_design:{preset:'glamour'}} without 'version' silently loses their preset on next GET (verified during this iteration before fixing the test payload). Prefer a tolerant check like `if card_design.get('version') or card_design.get('preset')`.

lives.py:1055 recording_status endpoint runs _daily GET inside the request path when status∈{processing,stopped} — this adds up to 2 external HTTP calls per polling tick. The frontend polls every ~5s on the summary page, so for a 60s wait this is ~24 Daily calls per host per live. Consider caching the daily status for N seconds in Mongo.

lives.py:_import_replay_to_cloudinary opens a sync pymongo client inside a background task — fine but it does not call client.close() if cloudinary.uploader.upload raises before the try block; it IS wrapped in finally, OK. Keep in mind the 43200s access-link expiry is honored only if import succeeds in time (status=ready_external otherwise).
lives.py:1113 live_summary queries live_questions + live_polls on every call — if a host repeatedly loads /lives/{id}/summary this is 3 DB round-trips. Could cache in live doc on live_end.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all 4 showcase presets + legacy regression + live summary + publish-to-drafts verified end-to-end; host live-record flow with real Daily camera NOT re-exercised since main agent already verified it manually)

rca of the issue: No new bugs. One architectural caveat (not a user-facing bug): backend ensure_design() ignores card_design.preset when version is missing, so any API client posting card_design without version will have their preset silently reset to the legacy-derived one on first GET. Frontend always sends version, so this does not affect current users — only external integrations. Reproduce: POST /api/cards with {card_design:{preset:'glamour'}} then GET → preset=='classic'. Mitigation suggested in action_items.
